verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web/UI framework (Axum server, components, render targets), not an agent or AI app that calls tools, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Its agent-facing features (AGENTS.md, Markdown docs routes, llms-full.txt) serve external agents and are not MCP-client capability. Nothing in the evidence shows Proa consuming MCP tools.
